hero.title: Reliable lighting. From the first show to the hundredth.
hero.description: We design and manufacture moving heads, washes, strobes, and control systems for touring, theatre, broadcast, and permanent installation.

positioning.title: A complete rig, from the head to the control surface.
positioning.description: Six platforms, one control language. Fixtures share connectors, protocols and service parts, so a rig assembled from the catalogue behaves as one system rather than a collection of purchases.

featured.title: Our most specified models
featured.body: Full photometric data, DMX charts and service documentation for every model.

applications_heading.title: Specified by the room, not by the brochure
applications_heading.body: Different rooms punish different weaknesses. Each application page lists the fixtures we would put in front of that brief.

manufacturing.title: Four steps we do not skip
manufacturing.body: Manufacturing discipline is the only reason a fixture bought in year three still matches one bought in year one.

distribution.title: Sold through partners who know the territory.
distribution.description: We supply through distributors and resellers in Europe, the Americas and Africa. Stock is held regionally, so quotes are drawn from availability rather than a production schedule.

cta.title: Send us the plot, the room or the shortlist.
cta.description: Tell us what the rig has to do and we will come back with a fixture list, the measured data behind it and the distributor who can quote it.

about.title: Professional lighting backed by data.
about.body: At Beamvox we design and manufacture stage lighting equipment with a focus on durability and measurable performance. Since 2016, we've grown from a local workshop to a global operator, serving theaters, tours, and broadcast studios.
about.company_title: Six people and one goniophotometer, to begin with
about.company_body_1: Beamvox started in 2016 as an optical workshop, building fixtures to order for touring companies who could not get the throw they needed from catalogue products. Measuring every unit was a practical necessity then. It became the way the company works.
about.company_body_2: Today the range spans beam, wash, effect, strobe, static and control products, assembled on an 4,100 m² floor with optical design, photometric verification and final test kept in house.
about.company_body_3: We sell through distributors and resellers only. That keeps our attention on the fixtures and keeps the customer relationship where it belongs.
about.factory_alt: Final quality control on the Beamvox production floor
about.values_title: Three positions we do not trade away
about.manufacturing_body: Design, verification and final assembly stay under one roof so a fault found in test reaches the engineer who drew the part.
about.compliance_body: Declarations of conformity are published per model. Placeholder list pending certificate audit.
about.cta_title: Ask us for the measured data
about.cta_body: Send a rig, a venue or a spec sheet. We will tell you which fixtures fit and which do not.

capabilities.title: In-house optical design
capabilities.body: Lens systems, reflectors and gobo paths are designed and simulated in-house, then verified against physical prototypes before tooling is cut.

capabilities.title: Photometric verification
capabilities.body: Every model is measured on a goniophotometer and published with the data that measurement produced. No estimates, no rounded-up lumen figures.

capabilities.title: Batch colour calibration
capabilities.body: LED fixtures are calibrated at assembly against a reference unit, so a fixture bought in year three still matches one bought in year one.

capabilities.title: Burn-in and shake test
capabilities.body: Every unit runs a timed burn-in with movement cycling, plus a vibration profile that approximates road transport, before it is packed.

timeline.title: Founded
timeline.body: Beamvox begins as a six-person optical workshop building custom fixtures for regional touring companies.

timeline.title: First catalogue range
timeline.body: The first standardised product range ships, alongside a published photometric dataset for every model.

timeline.title: European distribution
timeline.body: A stocked European warehouse opens, moving lead times on catalogue lines from months to days.

timeline.title: IP65 platform
timeline.body: The sealed head platform enters production, bringing touring-grade fixtures to permanent outdoor installation.

timeline.title: Americas and Africa
timeline.body: Regional service partners are appointed, with local spare parts and warranty handling.

timeline.title: Control platform
timeline.body: The Command console and Node range complete the rig, from fixture to control surface.

values.title: Publish the measurement
values.body: Every figure on this site comes from a measured unit, or it is marked as a placeholder. We would rather lose a comparison than win it with a number we cannot defend.

values.title: Build for the tenth year
values.body: Fixtures are designed around service access and parts availability, because most of a fixture's life happens after the sale.

values.title: Sell through partners
values.body: Our distributors own the customer relationship. We do not compete with them for the accounts they build.

products.title: Beam & Strobe — Our bestsellers
products.body: Every fixture ships with a published DMX chart, a GDTF profile and measured photometric data. Configured and OEM variants are quoted on request.
products.config_title: Not in the catalogue? It is probably still buildable.
products.config_body: Housing colour, connector layout, voltage configuration, firmware defaults and branding can be specified from an agreed minimum quantity. Optical changes are assessed case by case, with a sample before tooling.

product.not_found_body: The product you're looking for doesn't exist or has been removed.
product.highlights_body: Every fixture is built with these core features that set it apart.
product.cta_body: Contact our team for pricing, availability, or to request a demo unit.

applications_page.title: Every room punishes a different weakness.
applications_page.body: Touring kills connectors. Theatre hears fans. Broadcast sees flicker. Clubs cook housings. These are the fixtures we would put in front of each brief, and why.
applications_page.cta_title: Send the room and we will send the list.
applications_page.cta_body: Plot, venue dimensions, throw distances or an existing fixture schedule — any of those is enough for us to propose a rig and the data behind it.

why.title: The quiet argument: our numbers survive scrutiny.
why.body: Anyone can print a bigger figure on a spec sheet. The test is whether the fixture still measures that way after a season on the road, and whether the next batch matches the last one.
why.specs_title: How we state a figure, and how it is usually stated
why.specs_body: Not a competitor comparison — a description of the two conventions you will meet while comparing quotes.
why.manufacturing_title: Four steps between the board and the box
why.after_sale_title: Most of a fixture's life happens after the invoice
why.after_sale_body: Purchase price is a small part of what a rig costs over ten years. These are the commitments that decide the rest.
why.compliance_note: Certification scope varies by model and market. Declarations of conformity are published for every fixture in the downloads section. Placeholder listing pending final certification records.
why.cta_title: Test the claims with a demo unit.
why.cta_body: Evaluation stock is available through regional distributors. Measure it yourself against the published data.

support.title: Need documentation? Just ask.
support.body: Manuals, DMX charts, GDTF profiles, photometric files and firmware for every model in the range. Placeholder files for review — links resolve once the document library is connected.
support.service_title: If a fixture fails, this is the path.
support.service_body: 12 months on parts and labour, handled regionally. Common wear parts are held in all three served regions, and certified partners carry out warranty work locally.
support.step_1_body: Warranty and service run through the partner that supplied the fixture. They hold the invoice, the stock and the authority to replace.
support.step_2_body: Model, serial number, firmware version, operating hours and a short description of the fault. A phone video of the behaviour saves a week.
support.step_3_body: Issued within two working days, with return instructions and, where stock allows, a replacement dispatched ahead of the return.
support.faq_contact: Something not covered here? Technical questions reach an engineer, not a ticket queue —

faqs.q: What is covered by the 12-month warranty?
faqs.a: Parts and labour on manufacturing defects for 12 months from the invoice date, handled through the distributor that supplied the fixture. Consumables such as lamps and gobos are covered for 12 months.
Configured or OEM orders are quoted with a confirmed production window at the time of order.

faqs.q: Do you supply OEM and ODM configurations?
faqs.a: Yes. Housing colour, connector layout, voltage configuration and branding can be specified from an agreed minimum order quantity. Optical modifications are assessed case by case.

faqs.q: Are fixtures compatible with my console?
faqs.a: Every model ships with a GDTF profile and a published DMX chart. Personalities for major console platforms are available in the downloads section.

faqs.q: Can I request a demonstration unit?
faqs.a: Demonstration stock is available through regional distributors for evaluation. Contact us and we will route the request to the nearest partner.
